name: Michelle L. Harden
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in Denver, Colorado
side_practice_areas: Medical Malpractice, Business Litigation, Health Care
about: Michelle L. Harden is an attorney at Messner Reeves LLP and helps clients address Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Defense legal issues. She also assists clients regarding Business Litigation, Health Care and Food and Drugs issues.
Super Lawyers is a designation of top-rated practicing attorneys selected through extensive evaluation. She was awarded this distinction for 2017 - 2027.
Michelle Harden graduated in 2005 from University of Colorado Law School.
Michelle Harden was admitted to practice law in 2005. She represents clients in the Denver area.
